notes: State-machine controller (approach, descend, close, lift, carry, lower, release, retreat) using live hand and can positions and IK with the gripper pointing down. 21 of 22 episodes succeeded: the one failure was the first version, which stalled in the lift phase and was fixed by looser phase tolerances and timeouts; all 21 later runs (practice setup over 6 seeds, 3 hand-picked layouts, 12 random layouts) succeeded with place error 0.6-1.8 cm.
